title: Plant Systems
description: Recognizes mastery of the connected structural systems that carry the plant from seed anatomy through roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and trichomes.

title: Flow Dynamics
description: Recognizes mastery of root absorption, vascular movement, stomatal exchange, transpiration demand, and root-zone interactions.

title: Diagnostic Observer
description: Recognizes an observation-first diagnostic workflow built around pattern description, measurement context, and differential reasoning.

title: Canopy Architect
description: Recognizes mastery of nodes, apical dominance, directional growth, training response, canopy light distribution, and airflow.

title: Reproductive Biology
description: Recognizes mastery of preflowers, pollen biology, pollination response, seed formation, and controlled reproductive observation.

title: Floral Observer
description: Recognizes a repeatable approach to flower development, trichome sampling, microscope observation, and maturity-risk inspection.
